# Higgsfield

Higgsfield AI provides asynchronous image and video generation APIs powered by multiple creative AI models.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/higgsfield/.

## Actions

- **Cancel Request**: Cancel a Higgsfield generation request while it is still queued.
- **Create Character Reference**: Start training a reusable Higgsfield Soul ID character reference from one or more public images.
- **Estimate Soul V2 Cost** (read-only): Estimate the authenticated account's credit and USD cost for a fixed Higgsfield Soul V2 Standard image request without starting generation.
- **Generate Image**: Submit a text-to-image request to Higgsfield Soul Standard and return the request ID used to track the asynchronous result.
- **Generate Image With References**: Submit a Higgsfield Popcorn request that uses one or more reference images and return the request ID used to track the asynchronous result.
- **Generate Seedance 2 Text Video**: Submit a ByteDance Seedance 2.0 text-to-video request through Higgsfield and return the request handle used to track the asynchronous…
- **Generate Soul V2 Image**: Submit a text-to-image request to Higgsfield Soul V2 and return the request ID used to track the asynchronous result.
- **Generate Video From Image**: Generate a video from a publicly accessible starting image with Higgsfield DOP Lite and return the request ID used to track the…
- **Get Character Reference** (read-only): Get a Higgsfield Soul ID character reference and its current training status by ID.
- **Get Request Status** (read-only): Get the current state of a Higgsfield generation request and return generated image, video, or audio URLs when complete.
- **List SOUL V2 Styles** (read-only): List the SOUL V2 image styles available to the authenticated Higgsfield account, including the style IDs accepted by SOUL V2 generation…
